query:
UPDATE restaurants
            SET name = COALESCE($1, name),
                image_url = COALESCE($2, image_url),
                phone_number = COALESCE($3, phone_number),
                address = COALESCE($4, address),
                updated_at = NOW(),
                updated_by = $6
            WHERE id = $5
            RETURNING
                id,
                name as "name: Name",
                image_url as "image_url?: ImageSource",
                phone_number,
                sms_phone_number,
                address,
                created_at,
                created_by,
                updated_at,
                updated_by,
                availability_rule_id
